source: Note 1: The Great Egg was the size of a hatchling, and warm as the springs.

source: Note 2: It hummed when the north wind blew. The cliffs answered.

source: Note 3: Steam never touched it. The springs kept it from the cold.

source: Note 4: On the summit the sky turned green, and the egg glowed back.

source: Note 5: I kept it close all these years. Now it is yours, rider.

source: Note 1: The first {Ember} dragon slept in coals and woke at dawn.

source: Note 2: Its smoke climbed the north cliffs. The rocks still smell of it.
text: Nota 2: Su humo subió por los riscos del norte. Las rocas todavía huelen a él.

source: Note 3: It bathed in the springs, and the water stayed warm for years.
text: Nota 3: Se bañó en las termas, y el agua siguió caliente durante años.

source: Note 4: On the summit it lit the sky for lost riders.
text: Nota 4: En la cumbre iluminó el cielo para los jinetes perdidos.

source: Note 5: Its last cinder hatched a new flame. Look after yours.
text: Nota 5: Su última brasa hizo nacer una nueva llama. Cuida la tuya.

source: Note 1: {Dusk} dragons wake when the first star shows.
text: Nota 1: Los dragones {Dusk} despiertan cuando sale la primera estrella.

source: Note 2: They nest on the west cliffs, where the sun goes down.
text: Nota 2: Anidan en los riscos del oeste, donde se pone el sol.

source: Note 3: They drink moonlight from the springs, or so riders say.
text: Nota 3: Beben luz de luna en las termas, o eso dicen los jinetes.

source: Note 4: From the summit a {Dusk} dragon can see every nest on the island.
text: Nota 4: Desde la cumbre, un dragón {Dusk} ve todos los nidos de la isla.

source: Note 5: I raised one once. At night it never left my side.
text: Nota 5: Una vez crié uno. De noche nunca se apartaba de mí.

source: Your dragon must grow before the next Gloom
text: Tu dragón debe crecer antes de la próxima Penumbra
